# CLI command reference

[Documentation](../README.md) · [CLI workflows](../USAGE.md#use-the-cli)

Generated from `secure-agent help` in this checkout. Help does not contact the daemon.

```text
secure-agent — CLI for secure-agent daemon

Usage:
  secure-agent status                      Show daemon running status and active agents
  secure-agent flags                       List recent security correlation alerts
  secure-agent incidents                   Display incident reports and remediation checklists
  secure-agent events [--limit N]          List recent raw system events
  secure-agent audit [--limit N]           List the policy audit trail
  secure-agent cost [--since D] [--by G] [--tz M]   Model-call spend by repo|branch|harness|session|model|provider|day (--json for the raw body)
                                           --by provider: recorded provider, else the model's vendor; --by day: local days, oldest first
                                           --tz: minutes east of UTC for --by day (default: this machine's offset)
  secure-agent sessions [--harness H] [--repo R] [--branch B] [--since D] [--status S] [--limit N]  List sessions (--json for the raw body)
  secure-agent session <id-or-prefix>      Print what one session did — tools, models, cost, files, hosts, guard decisions, findings — as markdown (--json for the JSON report)
  secure-agent doctor [--json]             Self-check: hooks, file telemetry, collectors, traces, sessions, pairing, pricing, retention, egress; exit 1 on any failure
  secure-agent worktrees [--state S] [--repo R] [--stale] [--refresh] [--json]  Find every git worktree and say whether it can be removed (remove|review|keep|prune) and why
  secure-agent worktrees add|hide <path>   Put a repository on the worktree hunter's saved list, or hide it from reports
  secure-agent worktrees remove <path>     Remove a worktree whose fresh verdict is remove (git worktree remove, never --force; the branch stays)
  secure-agent worktrees prune <repo>      Drop git's entries for worktrees whose directory is gone
  secure-agent worktrees advise <path>     Ask the local advisor for a note on one worktree (advisory; never changes the verdict)
  secure-agent worktrees ask <path>        Resume the Claude Code or Codex session that worked in a keep/review worktree: open a PR for its work, or say it can go
  secure-agent cleanup [--kind K] [--project P] [--refresh] [--json]  .tmp and .quarantine folders, build output, tool and app caches: size, last touched, project, how to clear
  secure-agent cleanup trash <path>        Move one inventory item to the Trash on its volume
  secure-agent cleanup clean <tool>        Run a tool cache's own clean command (npm, go build, Homebrew, ...)
  secure-agent cleanup advise <repo|machine>  Ask the local advisor for a cleanup plan for one project (advisory)
  secure-agent cleanup log [--limit N] [--json]  What cleanups removed and the disk space each gave back
  secure-agent kill <PID>                  Terminate an agent process tree by PID
  secure-agent fleet                       Show THIS node's fleet identity (node_id, hostname, version) — remote rollups live at the collector's /fleet
  secure-agent fleet enroll <url>          Enroll this node into a collector: generate the secret, write fleet.webhooks, print the collector line
  secure-agent guard list                  List cached guard decisions
  secure-agent guard revoke <agent> <rule> Revoke a cached guard decision (forces a new prompt)
  secure-agent firewall mode <rule> <mode> Set a firewall rule mode (monitor|block)
  secure-agent firewall sources            List fingerprint ingest sources
  secure-agent fingerprint                 Scan configured sources and register secret fingerprints (HMAC only)
  secure-agent service install [daemon]    Install a headless launchd service (no menu bar app required)
  secure-agent service uninstall           Remove the headless service
  secure-agent service status              Show the headless service state
  secure-agent telemetry repair            Ask the menu bar app to re-register its file-telemetry helper; exit 1 unless it runs within 60 s
```
